findings.highlight: a big lake
findings.evidenceJa: 人の手が入っていない大きな池
findings.governingReading: a large pond untouched by human hands
findings.explanation: The pond’s untouched natural state disappears before its corruption is revealed.

findings.highlight: I follow behind Tohsaka
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の背中を守りながら後に続く
findings.governingReading: I follow while watching the surroundings and guarding Tohsaka’s back
findings.explanation: Shirou’s protective positioning behind Rin is omitted.

findings.highlight: almost enough to knock one unconscious
findings.evidenceJa: 見ただけで意識を裂く呪い。
findings.governingReading: a curse that tears consciousness apart merely by being seen
findings.explanation: A curse that actively rends consciousness is softened to near-fainting.

findings.highlight: I’ll weaken and sink into the mud if I walk a meter into it.
findings.evidenceJa: 一メートルも歩けずに衰弱し
findings.governingReading: I would weaken before managing even one meter
findings.explanation: Failure to cover even one meter becomes a consequence after walking that distance.

findings.highlight: as if grapevines took a human form
findings.evidenceJa: 葡萄が人型になったような奇怪さ
findings.governingReading: the grotesqueness of a cluster of grapes assuming human form
findings.explanation: The body’s clustered grape-like deformity becomes a plant-vine image.

findings.highlight: It’s going to destroy Shinji, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 核になっている慎二を壊すって
findings.governingReading: you mean destroying Shinji, who forms its core—
findings.explanation: The contemplated act of destroying the core becomes a prediction that the Grail itself will destroy Shinji.

findings.highlight: a gate the Holy Grail opens
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯によって開けられた孔
findings.governingReading: the hole opened by the Holy Grail
findings.explanation: The work’s hole or aperture is replaced with a constructed gate.

findings.highlight: That goldie just wants to open the gate.
findings.evidenceJa: 孔だけを開けるって言ってた
findings.governingReading: he said he would open only the hole
findings.explanation: A recalled statement about the limited operation becomes a claim about Gilgamesh’s desire.

findings.highlight: stop the Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯だけでも止めないと
findings.governingReading: at least stop the Grail itself
findings.explanation: The fallback distinction between stopping the Grail even if nothing else can be saved disappears.

findings.highlight: a curse made up of magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 呪いに加工された魔力
findings.governingReading: magical energy processed into a curse
findings.explanation: The transformation from mana into curse is reduced to a statement of material composition.

findings.highlight: magical energy that took physical form
findings.evidenceJa: カタチになった魔術
findings.governingReading: Magecraft given form
findings.explanation: The formed magical operation is changed into physically embodied raw mana.

findings.highlight: It’ll swallow you!
findings.evidenceJa: いいとこ真ん中で飲み込まれる
findings.governingReading: at best, it will swallow you halfway across
findings.explanation: Rin’s exact estimate that Shirou will fail around the pond’s midpoint disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber should be fighting right now.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーも今頃アイツと戦ってる筈だ。
findings.governingReading: Saber should be fighting that man by now
findings.explanation: Shirou’s mistaken belief that Saber is occupying Gilgamesh loses its object, weakening the coming surprise.

findings.highlight: A laugh.
findings.evidenceJa: 嘲笑う声。
findings.governingReading: a jeering voice
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s spoken mockery is reduced to an unspecified laugh.

findings.highlight: He appears here
findings.evidenceJa: 境内ではなくこの池に現れていた
findings.governingReading: he had appeared at this pond rather than in the temple grounds
findings.explanation: The reveal that Gilgamesh anticipated them and chose the pond instead of the expected battlefield disappears.

findings.highlight: I clench my fist
findings.evidenceJa: 指先に力を入れて
findings.governingReading: I put strength into my fingertips
findings.explanation: A precise preparation to trigger projection becomes a generic fighting gesture.

findings.highlight: I should be able to let Tohsaka escape
findings.evidenceJa: そうすれば最悪、遠坂を逃がすぐらい
findings.governingReading: then, at worst, I can at least let Tohsaka escape
findings.explanation: The fallback nature and limited ambition of Shirou’s fourteen prepared blueprints disappear.

findings.highlight: I am telling you two to stand there
findings.evidenceJa: そこでカカシになるがいい
findings.governingReading: stand there like scarecrows
findings.explanation: The dehumanizing scarecrow image is omitted in favor of plain staging.

findings.highlight: Can you stop him here, Shirou?
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎はここでアイツを止めて。
findings.governingReading: Shirou, stop him here
findings.explanation: Rin’s direct tactical order becomes a request questioning Shirou’s ability or willingness.

findings.highlight: I’m going to go pull Shinji out.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが責任をもって引っ張り出してくる
findings.governingReading: I will take responsibility for pulling Shinji out
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit assumption of responsibility for Shinji’s rescue disappears.

findings.highlight: go into that mud
findings.evidenceJa: 生身のまま、あの泥を突き進んでいく
findings.governingReading: push through that mud in her living body
findings.explanation: The contrast between Rin’s vulnerable flesh and the curse is omitted from Shirou’s alarm.

findings.highlight: He laughs, as if to look down
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは口汚く笑いやがった。
findings.governingReading: he laughed foully, sneering down at Rin’s resolve
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s coarse verbal cruelty is reduced to a tentative description of condescension.

findings.highlight: Go through that curse?
findings.evidenceJa: とんだ三流どもだ
findings.governingReading: what consummate third-raters you are
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s ranking insult disappears from his contemptuous response.

findings.highlight: a half-spirit like you guys
findings.evidenceJa: アンタみたいに半霊体
findings.governingReading: half-spirit like you
findings.explanation: Rin’s contrast with the incarnated Gilgamesh is generalized to multiple people.

findings.highlight: Off…!
findings.evidenceJa: 完了
findings.governingReading: Complete, read as “Off”
findings.explanation: The completion statement is again replaced solely by its English ruby, reading locally as termination rather than successful completion.

findings.highlight: it is slashed down by Kanshou
findings.evidenceJa: 干将によって弾き落とされた
findings.governingReading: it is knocked down or deflected by Kanshou
findings.explanation: The defensive interception becomes a cutting attack.

findings.highlight: increase in number
findings.evidenceJa: 際限なく数を増していく
findings.governingReading: continue multiplying without limit
findings.explanation: The apparently limitless escalation of Gilgamesh’s arsenal is weakened to an unspecified increase.

findings.highlight: looks at me
findings.evidenceJa: 完全に俺だけを視界に収めた
findings.governingReading: brings only me fully within his field of vision
findings.explanation: Shirou’s successful diversion of Gilgamesh’s entire attention from Rin is weakened.

findings.highlight: It was out of compassion that I tried to kill her
findings.evidenceJa: 我が手を下すのはあくまで慈悲だった
findings.governingReading: it would merely have been mercy for me to strike her down
findings.explanation: Gilgamesh’s counterfactual justification becomes a false claim that he already tried to kill Rin.

findings.highlight: I shall teach you the difference between the fake and the real!
findings.evidenceJa: その身をもって、真偽の違いを知るがいい
findings.governingReading: learn through your own body the difference between true and false
findings.explanation: The threat of making Shirou physically experience the distinction becomes ordinary instruction.
